material_root_causes.requirement: A quantity that sits exactly on a tier ceiling is quoted in that tier.
material_root_causes.trigger: a quote asks for exactly the published ceiling quantity
material_root_causes.consequence: the customer is quoted from the next tier up

material_root_causes.requirement: An updated tier table is used by later quotes.
material_root_causes.trigger: an operator edits the table while the service keeps running
material_root_causes.consequence: quotes keep using the table captured when the process started
equivalent_formulations: reads the table captured at import time
